title: Saffransbröd (Saffron Bread)
description: A bread preparation made with saffron, wheat flour, and yeast.

ingredients.name: ½ kkp pearl sugar for brushing

steps: Dissolve the yeast in a little of the lukewarm milk.
Sift the wheat flour with the salt, set aside 3-4 kkp for rolling out, and pour the rest into a bowl.
Add the lukewarm milk with vigorous stirring, mix in the yeast, and beat the dough until smooth and glossy.
Set it in a warm place to rise to double size.

Dry the saffron in a warm oven, pound it, and dissolve it in brandy and work it into the dough together with the beaten eggs, the butter beaten to white foam, the sugar, and the cleaned and rinsed raisins.
Let the dough rise again and shape it into wreaths or braids, which are placed on well-cleaned and buttered baking sheets.
When the breads have risen, brush them with beaten eggs and sprinkle with scalded and chopped sweet almonds mixed with pearl sugar.
Bake in good oven heat.

title: Saft med vinsyra (Fruit Juice with Tartaric Acid)
description: Prepared with tartaric acid, strawberries or raspberries, and water.

ingredients.name: 2 kg. strawberries (approximately 4 liters) or 2 kg. raspberries (approximately 3.8 liters)
1 kg. granulated sugar per kilogram of juice

steps: Clean the berries, rinse them if necessary, and place them in a pot.
Dissolve the tartaric acid in 1 deciliter boiling water, mix it with the cold water and pour it over the berries, which should then stand covered for 24 hours.
Strain the berries in cheesecloth and let them drip.
Measure the juice and add the sugar, then stir slowly with an enameled spoon until the sugar is melted, or approximately 1 hour.
Skim the juice and pour it hot into dry bottles, which are closed with clean cotton dipped in salicylic acid powder, and then bound with parchment paper (see page 505).

title: Salted Meat (Saltning av Kött)
description: Prepared with meat, saltpeter, and salt.

ingredients.name: For the brine: 10 liters cold water

steps: Cut the meat into suitable pieces (see butchering plans), remove all glands carefully.
Rub the meat pieces lightly with a mixture of 708 gr finely pounded coarse salt, 6 gr finely pounded potassium nitrate and 6 gr granulated sugar.
Place them in a stone or earthenware vessel that has been scoured with hot water and sprinkled with salt.

Prepare the brine by dissolving 1.7 kg coarse salt, 50 gr saltpeter and 50 gr granulated sugar in 10 liters cold water. Do not boil the brine, only dissolve the spices in the water, then skim it and it is ready.
Pour the brine immediately over the meat.
Add a bottom and a light weight, and pour in enough brine so that it stands well over the meat.

After 10-12 days, transfer the meat to another vessel treated in the same way, and skim the same brine in which the meat lay well and pour it over. Repeat this every week until the meat or pork is completely salted.

title: Saltning av fårkött (Salting Lamb Meat)
description: Prepared with lamb, saltpeter, and butter.
steps: If salting only a smaller supply of meat, Höganäs jars (glazed inside and outside) can be used advantageously.
For salting larger supplies, wooden vessels are used.
Oak or ash vessels are best, but pine vessels can also be used.
Before use, the wooden vessels should be boiled out with juniper brine.
The brine is made from water and juniper twigs and is poured into the vessel, which should be filled to the brim.
Let the brine stand until it has cooled; then pour it out and dry the vessel well.
Rub the bottom and sides with salt, and additionally place a fairly thick layer of coarse salt on the bottom.
Now cut the meat into pieces.
First cut off steaks and shoulder pieces, then cut the remaining meat into appropriately sized pieces.
Remove all glands, and rub the meat well, especially near the bones, with a mixture of salt, sugar, and saltpeter.
For 2 kg of meat calculate: 6 tablespoons butter salt, 3 tablespoons sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons potassium saltpeter.
The saltpeter prevents the red meat color from being lost during salting.
Although the saltpeter makes the meat tough, this is counteracted by the sugar.
Layer the meat in the prepared vessel alternating with salt.
Use coarse salt here, as it contains more salt than fine salt.
Place the skin sides down and the meat sides facing each other.
At the bottom, place steaks and shoulder pieces with the edges inward and as closely together as possible.
Fill all small cavities with salt, and place salt between the meat pieces so that they do not directly touch each other.
When all the meat is layered, spread a thick layer of salt on top.

title: Saltning av lax (Curing of Salmon)
description: Prepared with salmon, salt, and butter.
steps: Brush and rinse the salmon well.
Cut it open carefully so that the gall is not broken, clean and wash well.
Split it into two halves, leaving some of the flesh on both sides of the backbone attached to the spine.
Remove the side fins.
The head, backbone and fins can be salted separately.
Cut the fillets into smaller pieces.
Rub these with a mixture of salt, sugar and nitrate.
An alternative method is to dissolve the nitrate in a little water, wash the fish pieces with this and then rub them with sugar and salt.
Line a glazed stone crock or wooden tub with salt.
Place the salmon with skin side down and sprinkle with a mixture of coarse and fine salt.
Layer the salmon pieces with flesh side to flesh side, skin side to skin side and with salt between each layer.
Sprinkle salt on top and place a lid with weight on it.
For fish, no special brine is cooked, but it can remain in the brine formed during salting, or in a brine made from cold water and salt.
The salmon must therefore be checked often and the pieces turned, placing the top pieces at the bottom and vice versa.

steps: Clean the sole, rinse well and dry; trim the fins. Make a deep cut with a pointed knife along both sides of the backbone and carefully cut the fillets from the bone so they do not break. Roll out the dough to approximately 2 mm thickness, and cut out small cakes with a measure
Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks
Brush the cakes with this and sprinkle with chopped almond and sugar
Bake in weak oven heat
